Twelfth closed beta of Verso.

- Read Markdown files (.md and .markdown), with YAML frontmatter, tables,
  task lists, footnotes, code blocks, covers and relative images.
- Upload and download Markdown files over Wi-Fi.
- New Alignment setting (Book, Left or Justify) replaces the Justify switch
  and keeps centered or right-aligned EPUB text intact.
- Fix ragged selection edges and menu ghosting on older Kindles such as
  Paperwhite 4.
